reasoning: 驗證 PROXI 參數 Rear_View_Camera 為 Absent 時，TLM 不顯示 Dynamic Grid 設定。關鍵情境為 PROXI 組態分支，屬功能可用性之閘門。本 Req 只述單一 PROXI 值之結果，1 條即足；其對偶值由同族另一條覆蓋（§8.2.1 委任）。Rear_View_Camera 之段 1 命中 PROXI Format r401 逐字（0 = Absent／1 = Present），依 R-P375(c) 走 PROXI 路徑，不加 $。

tcs.tc_title: Dynamic Grid setting hidden when rear camera PROXI is Absent
pre_conditions: The TLM is in the Vehicle Settings menu
test_procedure: Read the named UI element "Vehicle Settings" menu list and check that it does not contain "Dynamic Grid"
Attempt to select "Dynamic Grid" in the "Vehicle Settings" menu list
expected_result: The named UI element "Dynamic Grid" is not present in the "Vehicle Settings" menu list
The named UI element "Dynamic Grid" cannot be selected and no setting screen is displayed
tcs.test_item:
If $Rear_View_Camera$ = [Absent], the TLM shall not display the corresponding customer setting
(PROXI Absent branch: the Dynamic Grid setting is not offered)

distinguishing_axis.delta: PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 0 (Absent)，與 -030 之 1 (Present) 對偶

tcs.remarks: PROXI anchor: PROXI_HDCC27_R3 Format r401 column F is "Rear_View_Camera" with 0 = Absent and 1 = Present (verbatim match). UI element names are taken from the setting wording named in the spec section and in the 037 description (R-VL21(a)); they are not anchored in HMI Settings List
